instruction: Split the employee data in column A into First Name, Last Name, and Rank columns. Then add a column E titled 'Initials' with each employee's initials (first letter of first name + first letter of last name).

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully split mixed employee data (FirstName LastName Rank) from column A into separate First Name (B), Last Name (C), and Rank (D) columns using formulas in LibreOffice Calc. Completed in 20 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc cells, enter formulas for text splitting (LEFT, MID, RIGHT, FIND), copy formulas down columns, handle multi-word parsing
metadata.explanation: Extends the original text-splitting task by also requiring initials extraction into column E. Getter reads columns B, C, E; metric checks header, split data, and initials correctness with partial credit.
metadata.task_rationale: Model proved it can split text in Calc. This variation adds a derived column (initials) requiring additional formula work.

scoring_breakdown.split_data: 0.4 - First name and last name columns populated

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts column E header, initials (E2:E22), first names (B2:B22), and last names (C2:C22) with 21 data rows matching the 21 expected initials.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_initials') which is correct since expected IS the rules dict.
Partial credit scoring is well-structured: 0.2 for header, 0.4 for split data presence, 0.4 for initials correctness with proportional matching.
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state.

Coverage gap: Instruction explicitly requires splitting into 'First Name, Last Name, and Rank columns' but the evaluator does not verify column D (Rank) at all. Only First Name (B) and Last Name (C) are checked for non-null presence.
Initials comparison uses case-insensitive matching with strip(), which is robust against minor formatting differences.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification of the Rank column (D) to the getter and metric. The getter should also read column D values, and the metric should check that column D has non-null rank data for at least 20 of the 21 rows, allocating some partial credit (e.g., redistribute: 0.15 header, 0.35 split data including rank, 0.5 initials).
